title: THE SENTRY, REDRAWN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of every character and machine, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders, silhouettes first. The Sentry was a grey filing cabinet on a skateboard: no dark outline, so on a dark floor it melted away and only its glows showed; one flat grey; a thin single barrel; and an amber eye even when it had seen nothing. It is redrawn: a dark outline round the tread, hull, head and gun; tread teeth that run as it rolls; a lit top and left edge with the right side in shade, so it has volume; a sloped front plate on the side it faces; two yellow hazard chevrons; rivets, seams and chipped paint; a camera head on a mast with a round lens that tells you its mood (dim white idle, amber suspicious, red hunting, orange when its vent is overheated); a whip antenna; and a twin-barrel gun under a cooling shroud. The whole body turns to face where it is going. An elite wears a brass edge and a second antenna. Nothing about play changes: same size, same shadow, same weak points.
now: The Sentry is redrawn: outlined, lit, a camera eye that shows its mood, twin barrels.
